recognize_zh: 萎縮退化的濾泡中心細胞少、由樹突狀細胞與一條帶粉紅色玻璃樣物質的小血管穿入，周圍小淋巴球排成一圈圈同心圓狀的被套層（洋蔥皮樣 onion skinning），是透明血管型 Castleman 病的典型濾泡。
features: Regressed (atretic) follicle with a small germinal center depleted of lymphocytes
Germinal center composed mainly of follicular dendritic cells with oval vesicular nuclei and a penetrating small vessel with eosinophilic hyalinized wall
Expanded mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric layers (onion-skin pattern)
Interfollicular area with small lymphocytes and prominent high endothelial venules
No sheets of plasma cells or atypical large cells in this field
describe_en: Lymph node section shows a regressed follicle with a small, lymphocyte-depleted germinal center composed predominantly of follicular dendritic cells and penetrated by a small vessel with a hyalinized eosinophilic wall. The surrounding mantle zone is expanded, with small lymphocytes arranged in tight concentric rings imparting an onion-skin appearance. The interfollicular region contains small lymphocytes and prominent vessels without sheets of plasma cells. Findings are consistent with hyaline vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Shows regressed follicles as well, but with interfollicular sheets of plasma cells and LANA-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zones, plus systemic symptoms.
Has regressed or hyperplastic follicles with more prominent interfollicular plasmacytosis and systemic inflammation, and is HHV8 negative.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Expanded mantles surround naked germinal centers but consist of monotonous cyclin D1-positive CD5+ B cells rather than polyclonal concentric small lymphocytes.

Regressed follicles with vascular proliferation may be seen, but there is a polymorphous infiltrate of clear atypical T cells expressing TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13) with expanded FDC meshworks outside follicles.
